release_rule: A crop must not be marked AI-supported until suitable disease classes, training data, external validation and field-style testing are complete.
model_strategy: Prefer a crop-recognition stage followed by crop-specific disease models instead of one ever-growing crop-by-disease classifier.
notes: The current crop identifier is a bootstrap suggestion derived from the four-crop disease model and always requires farmer confirmation.
Unsupported crops must not be forced into one of the four current diagnosis classes.
Some crops require affected-part imaging rather than leaf-only imaging, for example mushrooms, onions, fruits and stems.
Translations used in the app should receive native-speaker and agricultural terminology review before public release.
